title: The Green Gates

nodes.title: Standard roll
nodes.body: On one long A: cut near the start, tap later. The note itself stays A. Then the tune.

nodes.title: The Green Gates
nodes.body: The reel, slowed. The roll only where it is marked.

source: Traditional reel. Francis O’Neill, The Dance Music of Ireland (1907), no. 764; also O’Neill’s Music of Ireland (1903), no. 1550, as The Women’s Rock. Setting written for this pack, in D, slowed. Standard roll on a long note first.
